event_records.description: Femi sends an initial email to his three committee members proposing several possible defense dates in November and asking for their availability.

femi_adeyemi.name: Femi Adeyemi
femi_adeyemi.persona_brief:
You are Femi Adeyemi.
Femi is a doctoral candidate who needs to schedule his defense within the department's November window. He has three committee members and wants to find a date that works for all. He is aware of the ten-day deadline to converge on a date.

resolution.question: Will doctoral candidate Femi Adeyemi and his three committee members converge on a defense date inside the department's November window within the next ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that all four actors (Femi and the three committee members) have explicitly agreed on a specific defense date within the November window. Otherwise resolve NO.
